notes: Web 402 — BANNER-OVERLAP-TOP-NOV10 (owner Nov 10, 2026 09:56 CST, his Preferences/Advanced screenshot: the orange 'Update available — Tap to download v74' bar sits ON TOP of the app again — the .topbar half-hidden beneath it, the top of the scrolled content cut off; the dashboard shows the same clip). CONVICTION: the js/app.js half of web 380 never stopped working — the bar lands, is measured, and --updBannerH + the updBannerOn class are set (proven in a real Chromium layout run against the shipped bytes: class and var present, computed padding-top 0px). The CSS half was LOST IN THE WEB 396 SHIP: web 380 (9c0293c) shipped the two consuming rules (body.updBannerOn padding-top + the sticky-heads top offset), every css through web 395 kept them, and 7593ed4 (web 396) rebuilt css/style.css from a base that predated them and dropped both while re-pinning the file. The v380 suite kept passing because it ran in the main dev tree, whose uncommitted css still carries the rules; ships build from clean live worktrees, where they were gone. Nothing consuming the reservation → sticky heads stick at top:0 under the fixed bar, every screen (dashboard and module screens share the one #main layout), any bar height. THE FIX: (1) css/style.css — the two v380 rules restored VERBATIM, with the story written above them so the next rebuild knows they are load-bearing; (2) js/app.js — the banner code now RE-MEASURES the bar after landing (window resize + orientationchange, document.fonts.ready, a guarded ResizeObserver on the bar) and hands the layout the new height when it changes: a fold/unfold or rotation re-wraps the bar taller and a one-shot reservation under-reserves by exactly that growth. Same-height reads are no-ops; the bar itself is byte-untouched (still fixed, still the download door); no bar → no class, no var → layout exactly as before.
